# Kraftzen

> An AI studio in Delhi, India. We build AI tools, workflow automation, websites
> and automated content systems for teams of five to fifty people. Two of our own
> products are live in public. Clients get a fixed quote, a date, and full
> ownership of the code.

Contact: officialkraftzen@gmail.com, +91 9310367672. Founder: Garvish Dua.

Pricing is quoted per project after one call. There is no published rate card.
We work with clients outside India. Clients own the code, the accounts and the
documentation at the end of every project.

## Services

- [AI tools and agents](https://kraftzen.in/services#ai-tools-and-agents): task specific tools and agents built around one job a team repeats.
- [Workflow automation](https://kraftzen.in/services#workflow-automation): pipelines that move work between existing tools, with error handling and a readable run log.
- [Websites and web apps](https://kraftzen.in/services#websites-and-web-apps): marketing sites, product sites and landing pages in React or WordPress, with technical SEO built in.
- [Automated content systems](https://kraftzen.in/services#automated-content-systems): automated blog engines on your own domain, with research, drafting, internal linking and indexing handled.

## Products

Kraftzen has exactly two products of its own. Both are live.

- [Bro AI](https://bro.ai.in): five narrow AI tools behind one login. Designer Bro for visuals, headshots and thumbnails from a brief. Gen-Z Bro for photos rendered in whatever art style is trending. Animator Bro for motion from a static design. Portfolio Bro for portfolio sites. Emailer Bro for campaign copy and sequences.
- [AniVerseX](https://aniblogs.vercel.app): a blog that runs itself, covering topic research, drafting, internal linking and indexing, with no person in the loop unless you want one. The same system is what we rebuild for clients.

## How engagements work

- [Start a project](https://kraftzen.in/contact): send an enquiry, get a reply within one business day, then a 30 minute call to understand the actual work, then a fixed price and a date in writing.
- [Sprint](https://kraftzen.in/services): one to two weeks, one scoped deliverable.
- [Build](https://kraftzen.in/services): three to eight weeks, a custom tool, content system or full site.
- [Ongoing](https://kraftzen.in/services): monthly, cancel anytime. We keep running and extending what we built.
